tagline: Faster AI with Windows ML on any DirectX 12 graphics card
summary: The same AI features, sped up by any modern graphics card (AMD, Intel, NVIDIA or Qualcomm) with nothing else to install. On Windows 11 24H2 and newer, Windows adds vendor-tuned speedups by itself, and Drift falls back to the processor if the card can't be used.
useCases: Speed up AI tools on any Windows graphics card
howTo: Open the AI engine details and choose a graphics option, or leave it on Automatic
